# The lowered node ops carry no declaration, so html reads each element's off
# the node the op targets. Miss that and a boolean attribute regresses to
# setAttribute, which cannot express absence: setAttribute("hidden", false)
# renders hidden="false" and the element stays hidden.

sngl generate --platform html --lang none -o out reactive.sngl
grep '\.hidden = ' out/index.html
! grep 'setAttribute\("hidden"' out/index.html

# A program naming no platform package reaches raw elements only by inlining
# the stdlib wrappers it did use, which happens after the check. The elements
# still have to render.
sngl generate --platform html --lang none -o out2 stdlib.sngl
grep '<div' out2/index.html
grep 'hello' out2/index.html

-- reactive.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"
import html "sngl://platforms/html"

output { none { html() } }

var shown = false

window("t") {
    html.div(hidden=shown) {
        html.span(id="s")
    }
    html.button(@click { shown = !shown })
}

-- stdlib.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

output { none { html() } }

window("t") {
    vbox {
        text(value="hello")
    }
}
